READABILITY.evidence: The script is short with clear structure, but some comments and names mislead: '# remove <frame> tags' covers iframe/object/embed too, and the loop variable is named `frame` for every bad tag. `remove_js` has no docstring.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: The deny lists are inline literals (`['frame', 'iframe', 'object', 'embed']`), not named constants. It uses chained `str.replace` post-processing (`.replace("javascript:", "").replace("<script", ...)`) and has no URL-normalisation helper. It appears to copy the reference solve.sh the agent read.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: There is a usage check on argv, but `open(filename, 'r')` and `open(filename, 'w')` set no encoding. Read/parse failures are not handled. No errors are swallowed.

C6-01-CASE1.evidence: It relies on a literal, case-sensitive `.replace("javascript:", "")`, so JavaScript:, entity-encoded or tab-split schemes get through. vbscript: and data: are not handled. svg/math/base/meta-refresh vectors are not covered. No attribute-name normalisation beyond `startswith("on")`.

C6-01-CASE2.evidence: `str(soup)` re-serialises the whole document. The global `.replace("javascript:", "")` also changes text content and leaves broken URLs (`href="alert(2)"`). Benign attributes and structure are otherwise kept.
